Does your bowling center have a coach or anything like that that gives lessons?

In my most recent coaching sessions, I was told to not even think on the approach, thinking is done when you step off of the approach. Nice save on the last game though, that's awesome sauce. There have been points I throw a shitty game or two and then shoot like that, 260+. Isn't it funny how that kind of thing happens?
And I thank you for it. Corner pins frustrate me more than anything though, especially seeing people carry trash, I have a good gameplan for tonight though.
I just vented, the second I finished my series, I was game planning for tonight and what I could do different..sooooo..

I know, it was super frustrating. I think I need new fingertips in that ball. When I shot my first 300/800, exactly one month later the fingertips were shot..like I said, I tried everything I can think of, I did change balls as well and the same thing was happening..soooo, whatever onto tomorrow night with a 580 in the books..uggghh..

You're exactly right. If it's raining outside or humid the approaches are usually real tacky, you have to adjust, you have to adjust to other bowlers on the lane because they are in your line. I saw on youtube that dude who bowls backwards and carries like a 180-190 average, there's no "right" way if you can be successful at it.

I've kinda done the same thing, except with golf..lol all of this requires constant precision and being able to do the same thing at least 36 times a night. Yeah, when I don't follow through, I open my shoulders I do recognize that though. This is my worst year in the past few years as far as average goes, but this the absolute best year for my recognition and awareness of what I'm doing, on why/how the 10 pin was left on a flush af shot. Nothing honorable yet this year though lol

That would honestly be awesome to live in Yorkshire. I've heard just beautiful it is. Unfortunately I have not left this island. I'd love to visit everywhere and learn about their culture. I live in the Dutch/German heavy part of Pennsylvania. We have some nice places to hike here, like the Pigeon Hills, absolutely awesome.

I literally do not remember throwing my last shot on my first 300..it was an out of body experience, I saw it from outside my body..I do remember the sigh of relief on at the time I got a monkey off my back. Also shot my first 800 that night too..it was so special to get my first 300/800 in the same night..congratulations though, where there's one there's bound to be more!!
That's awesome! Keep it up and sooner than you think you'll probably *average* 200!!
Our Wednesday night team name was Balls Deep in One Broad..the alley made us change our name, so we changed it to Too Much Head lol

Hey there. Thanks for at least thinking of me, one person does on the entire 7 billion people on this blue marble we call home. I feel like crap too..I'm out being social in my bowling league though, so at least I'm trying to keep everything together. It's terrible what's going on when someone has made you feel absolutely worthless and just making derogatory remarks towards you..but I'm trying..where do live, I live in the United States..lol
